title: Algorithmic Collusion and the Complexity of Information-Value-Free Equilibria
abstract: arXiv:2609.22757v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A (coarse) correlated equilibrium (CE) is information-value-free (IVF) if a player can match the payoff obtained from recommendations by committing to a fixed action. Motivated by the problem of regulating algorithmic collusion, this refinement was introduced by Hartline, Wang, and Zhang [EC'26], who showed that it can be computed in polynomial time in explicitly represented normal-form game. In this paper, we examine the complexity of IVF(C)CEs in succinct games, which model more realistic strategic interactions that feature either many players or exponentially many pure strategies.   We first show that computing an information-value-free CE is PPAD-complete in many-player polymatrix games or two-player Bayesian games, even when the approximation is a constant. translated_title: 算法合谋与无信息价值均衡的计算复杂性
translated_abstract: 如果一个玩家能够通过承诺采取某个固定行动来匹配从建议中获得的收益，那么（粗略）相关均衡（CE）就是无信息价值的（IVF）。出于监管算法合谋问题的动机，Hartline、Wang 和 Zhang [EC'26] 引入了这一精炼概念，并证明在显式表示的正规形式博弈中，该均衡可以在多项式时间内计算。在本文中，我们研究了简洁博弈中 IVF(C)CE 的计算复杂性，这类博弈刻画了更贴近现实的策略互动，其特征是玩家数量众多或纯策略数量呈指数级。我们首先证明，在多玩家多矩阵博弈或双人贝叶斯博弈中，计算无信息价值 CE 是 PPAD-完全的，即使近似精度仅为常数。我们还证明了一个无条件的指数级查询复杂度下界。我们的结果表明，即使在集中式模型中，IVFCE 也是难以处理的，并排除了……的存在（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文证明在简洁博弈（如多玩家多矩阵博弈和双人贝叶斯博弈）中计算无信息价值相关均衡是 PPAD-完全的，并给出无条件的指数级查询下界，表明该均衡即使在集中式模型中也难以求解。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that computing information-value-free correlated equilibria is PPAD-complete in succinct games such as many-player polymatrix games and two-player Bayesian games, and establishes an unconditional exponential query lower bound, showing their intractability even in the centralized model.
